title: Junior Business Analyst

company_info.type: Iranian company dealing with Iranian and foreign customers

job_description:
In the story of Snappfood, we believe in creating value that goes beyond the ordinary. We are willing to establish innovative tendencies and are eager to have you on our team to help us get through our business challenges with creativity, intelligence, and agility.
We are waiting for you to continue this story.
Responsibilities:
Conduct in-depth data analysis to derive insights that support commercial and operational strategies.
Create visually compelling presentations, dashboards, and reports to communicate insights effectively. Use tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or other visualization platforms.
Support the development of data models to streamline data analysis processes and enable predictive insights.
Identify growth opportunities through market, supply, and operational analysis.
Conduct rigorous testing and validation of models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Identify opportunities for model improvement or optimization based on evolving data trends and business requirements.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and report on performance metrics that are critical to the commercial department.
Provide timely and accurate ad-hoc reports based on specific needs or requests from stakeholders.
Support A/B testing and performance evaluation of business initiatives.
Requirements:
Expertise in identifying and rectifying errors, inconsistencies, and deficiencies in data to ensure data quality and reliability.
Proficiency in creating visualizations of data using tools such as Power BI and Tableau.
Ability to collect, transform, and structure raw data into usable formats for analysis, modeling, and reporting.
Ability to analyze data and develop models using Python or other similar tools.
Deep understanding of ethical issues related to data usage and responsible behavior in data control.
Benefits:
Credit for: Vacations, Gym, Therapy, Internet Costs
Complementary Insurance
Educational platform of advanced courses
Snappfood’s Discount codes
Loans
